data.long_meaning: Nausad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘nausasya’, meaning 'lord of pleasure'. In Hindu mythology, Nausad is the name of the god of pleasures who is believed to grant desires and fulfill wishes. He is often depicted as a young, handsome, and charming deity who is fond of music, dance, and wine. The name Nausad carries the meaning “Lord of Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nausad usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nausad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
